about: Foreground/background pairs that tokens.test.ts holds to a WCAG 2.x contrast minimum, in both themes. A group with "on": "surfaces" pairs every foreground with every surface; a group with "pairs" lists [foreground, background] explicitly. 102 pairs per theme.

groups.note: Dots, bars, icons, lanes and control boundaries on any surface (WCAG 1.4.11).
Status ink on its own soft fill, and text on a selected row.
Label text on solid fills, on navy chrome, and on every hover and pressed state.
The focus ring on navy chrome.

decorative.--accent-edge: outline of a soft accent fill
decorative.--ok-edge: outline of a soft status fill
decorative.--warn-edge: outline of a soft status fill
decorative.--error-edge: outline of a soft status fill
decorative.--diff-added: soft fill; the change also carries a glyph and an underline or strike
decorative.--diff-removed: soft fill; the change also carries a glyph and an underline or strike
decorative.--diff-rewritten: soft fill; the change also carries a glyph and an underline or strike
